BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.EMPTY.title: Empty Room in the Spire
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.EMPTY.description: An uneventful moment is the gentlest kindness.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.HIDE_BATTLE.title: Unknown Ferocity
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.HIDE_BATTLE.descrip: Keep moving forward. Courage is all you can rely on.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.HIDE_INVISIBLE.desc: Keep moving forward. Curiosity is the best guide.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.INCIDENT.title: Encounter
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.INCIDENT.descriptio: New friends, old foes... Adventures never grow old; only the scars do.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.WISH.title: Wish Fulfilled
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.WISH.description: There are countless ways to make a wish, but the wishes themselves are much the same.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.SACRIFICE.title: Lost and Found
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.SACRIFICE.descripti: The emptiness and uncertainty of loss give way to the satisfaction and joy of discovery.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.DUEL.title: Face-Off
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.DUEL.description: A conversation between hunter and prey.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.EXPEDITION.title: Scout
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.EXPEDITION.descript: Someone must go ahead to show the way for those who follow.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.BATTLE_SHOP.title: Rogue Trader
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.BATTLE_SHOP.descrip: Neither ally nor enemy. Some prefer to stand in between.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.SCRAP_SHOP.title: Hidden Trader
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.SCRAP_SHOP.descript: Secrets and journeys are weighed on the scales. As they sway, a price is set.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.DOOR.title: Bosky Passage
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.DOOR.rules:
Appears in pairs. Enter to travel to the other Bosky Passage.

※Entering costs action points; teleporting is free.
※You can walk through an unfinished passage.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.LIGHT.title: Vantage Point
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.LIGHT.description: Seeing is not reaching. Mark your destination, then plan the journey.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.LIGHT.rules:
Reveals itself and nodes within {InitialRadius} tiles when it appears.
On first arrival, reveals nodes within {ArrivalRadius} tiles and grants 1 action point.
The reward is still granted if Roaming “Residents” occupy the node.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.LIGHT.enhanced_cond: With “Split” unlocked in the Game of Life and Secrecy Level 3 or higher, the appearance/arrival ranges increase to 12/24 tiles.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.LIGHT.occupied_effe: This is still a Vantage Point: first arrival reveals {ArrivalRadius} tiles and grants 1 action point.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.FINAL.title: Journey's End
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.FINAL.description: Only the beginning of another search.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.EVACUATE.title: Perilous Trail
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.EVACUATE.descriptio: Shh. Keep this secret to yourself.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STORY.title: Prophecy
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.STORY.description: The choice lies before you. The outcome is already written.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.PORTAL.title: Into Wonderland
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.REST.title: A Safe Corner
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.REST.description: No one will disturb you here, and there is plenty of food and water. Take a moment to relax.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.BATTLE_SAVAGE.title: “Resident” Stronghold
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.BATTLE_SAVAGE.descr: When this stronghold appears, 0–3 Roaming “Residents” appear nearby.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.BATTLE_SAVAGE.rules:
Up to three residents start on original empty nodes within five road steps. Fewer appear if there are not enough eligible nodes.
Defeat the stronghold to claim rewards and immediately drive out all Roaming “Residents” in the region.
A group of roaming “Residents” has occupied this place. Driving them out will take a fierce battle.

Blocks through-travel. Defeat it to empty the node.
Moves one road step per journey; a passage transfer is included.
Avoids your location, exit bosses, repeatable nodes, strongholds and clearings created by completed encounters.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.EMPLOY.title: Emergency Support
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.HUNT.title: No Way Out
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.MAP.HUNT.description: It is hard to tell which is worse: the hounds, or the strange beast before you. One thing is certain: you do not want to become like them.
